subject: Dedicated capacity sizing & pricing review - multi-stakeholder sync
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Clara Tan <ctan@oceanicanalytics.com>, Ben Fisher <ben.fisher@oceanicanalytics.com>, procurement@oceanicanalytics.com, security@oceanicanalytics.com
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity sizing & pricing review - multi-stakeholder sync

Hi Clara / Ben / procurement / security team,

Thanks again for the time this week — great conversation about steady-state inference needs. To make progress on procurement and security sign-off, I want to book a single 60-minute review with your engineering, procurement, and security leads plus our SE (Stephanie) to walk through:

- Usage forecast & peak patterns (attached)
- Recommended Dedicated sizing options and cost trade-offs
- Data residency / audit log expectations for Private vs Dedicated
- Procurement next steps and timeline for PO/contracting

Proposed 60-min slots (all PT):
- Tue 3 Nov, 10:00–11:00
- Wed 4 Nov, 14:00–15:00
- Thu 5 Nov, 09:00–10:00

Attachments: OAA_usage_forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet) — includes 90/180/365-day projections we discussed. Also attaching a high-level options doc (redwood_dedicated_options.pdf) for your procurement team.

Can you confirm who from procurement/security will attend and which slot works? If none of these are workable, propose two alternatives and we’ll adjust.

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0172
[Attachment: OAA_usage_forecast.xlsx]
[Attachment: redwood_dedicated_options.pdf]

From: Clara Tan <ctan@oceanicanalytics.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Fisher <ben.fisher@oceanicanalytics.com>, procurement@oceanicanalytics.com, security@oceanicanalytics.com, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing & pricing review - multi-stakeholder sync

Thanks Rishi — appreciate the clear agenda.

We can do Tue 3 Nov 10:00–11:00 PT but Ben (procurement) has a half-day off that day; he asked if we could also consider Wed 4 Nov 14:00–15:00 PT as a backup. Security (Ayesha) will be able to join either.

Two quick asks from engineering before the call:
- Can you confirm whether the Dedicated sizing doc assumes 100% burst capacity or a 2x headroom rule?
- If possible, share an estimated monthly run-rate for the 90-day and 365-day forecasts so procurement has a ballpark for PO sizing.

If you want, send a calendar invite and we’ll accept.

Clara
Staff Software Engineer | Oceanic Analytics
ctan@oceanicanalytics.com

Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 31 Oct 2026 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing & pricing review - multi-stakeholder sync

Thanks Clara — appreciate the quick reply.

To answer your questions briefly:
- The options doc includes two sizing heuristics: (A) conservative (2x headroom on 95th percentile) and (B) burst-first (elastic bursts within agreed SLA, lower committed baseline). Stephanie will walk through assumptions in the call.
- I’ve added a short appendix to the options PDF with estimated monthly run-rate buckets for the 90-day and 365-day forecasts (ballpark ranges, non-binding). See redwood_dedicated_options.pdf — I’ll also paste the numbers at the start of the call.

I’ll tentatively hold Tue 3 Nov 10:00–11:00 PT and Wed 4 Nov 14:00–15:00 PT on the calendar; please confirm which of the two you prefer and who from procurement will lead the PO discussion.

Also looping Stephanie — Steph, can you confirm SE availability for either slot and whether you need any pre-call data from Clara’s team?

Best,
Rishi
[Attachment: redwood_dedicated_options.pdf]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Clara Tan <ctan@oceanicanalytics.com>, Ben Fisher <ben.fisher@oceanicanalytics.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, procurement@oceanicanalytics.com
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 07:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing & pricing review - multi-stakeholder sync

Hi all — I can run the sizing portion and confirm availability. Tue 3 Nov 10:00–11:00 PT works for me.

Attached is a 2-slide PDF with the sizing assumptions I’ll use on the call (sizing_assumptions_slide.pdf) — highlights:
- Baseline qps and 95p latency assumptions per model type
- Buffering policy: default 1.5x baseline for steady-state; optional 2x for mission-critical customers
- Cost buckets mapped to reserved GPU/instance mixes (monthly estimates)

Rishi — can we do a quick 15-min pre-call sync 30 minutes before the meeting to align on what we’ll present? Lauren, I’m CCing you in case we need an exception for any pricing concessions; happy to loop you in during the meeting if needed.

Thanks,
Steph
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
[Attachment: sizing_assumptions_slide.pdf]

Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing & pricing review - multi-stakeholder sync

Thanks Steph — Tue 3 Nov 10:00–11:00 PT confirmed on our side. Ben will join from procurement for the first 30 minutes; Ayesha from security will join the full hour.

We’d also appreciate if you could paste the monthly run-rate buckets into the calendar event or add them to the HubSpot deal so procurement has something to reference beforehand.

I’ll accept the invite once it’s sent.

Clara

All — thanks for pulling this together. Quick note from procurement: we need line-item monthly estimates (not just ranges) to scope the PO draft — even a conservative mid-point per bucket is fine. Also, our legal prefers to see the proposed SLA and log retention terms before signing.

Lauren — can you confirm who on Redwood Legal / Finance we should expect to interact with, and whether there’s a standard SOW template you use?

If it helps move things along I’ve shared a DocuSign link for NDA/engagement paperwork that I can send to the right contact once we have the numbers.

—Ben

ben.fisher@oceanicanalytics.com

Hi Rishi / Steph / Clara —

Quick update from procurement: our internal PO review pushed beyond the 3 Nov window. Can we move the full review to Wed 10 Nov, 10:00–11:00 PT? That slot keeps Ayesha (security) and the procurement lead aligned.

If 10 Nov isn't possible for Redwood, please propose two other slots next week. We still need the monthly line-item numbers in advance of the meeting so procurement can pre-populate the PO draft.

Thanks,
Oceanic Procurement Team
procurement@oceanicanalytics.com
